entities.name: C9H12 HOMO energy
observations: Calculated HOMO energy is -0.2379732692 Ha using converged PySCF B3LYP/def2-SVP RKS single-point calculation on an MMFF-optimized RDKit conformer.
This is a method- and geometry-dependent calculated orbital energy, not an experimentally measured constant.
